title: The ZIA configuration audit (System Audit Report) endpoint

prose.text: Despite the name, this is not a change history. {{not-a-trail}} For who-changed-what use [[zia.audit-logs.what-is-recorded]].

prose.label: Access.
prose.text: {{oneapi-only}} {{rba-limited}} The scope behavior is documented for this endpoint only; the audit-report endpoints are an open question in [[zia.audit-logs.report-api]] (gap `reports-scope`).

checks.do: Whether a grade is quoted with its `reportTimestamp` and `dataPresent`, which show the date it describes and whether data was present.

not-a-trail.statement: The configAudit endpoint returns the System Audit Report, a graded assessment of the current configuration, not a log of who changed what.

expect.description:
Retrieves the System Audit Report. To learn more, see About the System Audit Report.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

quotes: The System Audit Report highlights the status of GRE tunnels, PAC files, authentication frequency, PAC file sizes, Microsoft 365 One Click, and IP visibility.

oneapi-only.statement: The configAudit, configAudit/ipVisibility and configAudit/pacFile endpoints are accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

expect.description:
Retrieves the System Audit Report. To learn more, see About the System Audit Report.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Retrieves the IP visibility audit report.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Retrieves the PAC file audit report.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

monthly.statement: The report runs on the first of every month and presents the analysis as of that date; if the previous month's report is unavailable the console shows the month before it.

quotes: The report runs on the first of every month, and the analysis is presented on everything as of that date.
you'll be shown the month prior to the previous month's report

grades.statement: The response carries an overallGrade plus highAvailabilityGrade, userPerformanceGrade, otherGrade, greTunnelGrade, pacFileGrade, authFrequencyGrade, pacfileSizeGrade, office365Grade and ipVisibilityGrade, each A, B, C or NONE.

recommendations.statement: Each area also has a free-text recommended-configuration field (greTunnelRecommendedConfiguration, pacFileRecommendedConfiguration, authFrequencyRecommendedConfiguration, pacFileSizeRecommendedConfiguration, office365RecommendedConfiguration, ipVisibilityRecommendedConfiguration); the response also has office365Flag, dataPresent, reportTimestamp and an authFrequency object with authFrequency and authCustomFrequency.

grade-rubric.statement: GRE tunnel and PAC file grades are A when issues affect under 10% of the items, B between 10% and 90%, and C above 90%; with none present the grade is No Grade.

quotes: | Issues with less than 10% of all GRE tunnels | A |
| Issues with more than 90% of all GRE tunnels | C |

rba-limited.statement: The Python SDK comment states that the config audit returns the code RBA_LIMITED with the message "Functional scope restriction requires Reports" when the Reports functional scope is missing.

python-models.statement: The Python SDK exposes the report as SystemAuditReportAPI.get_config_audit (client.zia.system_audit) and models the nested objects AuthFrequency, IPVisibility (totalGreLocations, recommendation, details, locationsWithNat) and PacFile (totalPacFiles, pacWithStaticIPs).

grade-is-snapshot.statement: A System Audit Report grade describes the configuration as of the date the report was run, not the configuration as it is now.
grade-is-snapshot.conditions: The report is generated on the first of the month and presents analysis as of that date; assumes no on-demand refresh exists, which no source mentions.
